name: Bialetti Uruguay
description: Online store for the Bialetti brand in Uruguay on WooCommerce. Sells moka pots and other coffee makers, whole-bean and ground coffee. States free shipping across the country for purchases above a stated amount; smaller orders go by the carrier agency the buyer chooses, paid on delivery.
description_es: Tienda online de la marca Bialetti en Uruguay sobre WooCommerce. Vende cafeteras moka y otras cafeteras, café en grano y molido. Indica envío gratis a todo el país para compras por encima de un monto indicado; las compras menores se despachan por la agencia de transporte que elige el comprador, con pago en destino.

ships_to.notes: Free shipping across the country above UYU 2,500; smaller orders by the buyer's chosen carrier agency, paid on delivery. Source is search excerpts of the store's own pages.
